audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 3 disagree with the packet and with their own prose. Row 1 prints Gnar above whys[1] "At Level 2 you out-stat squishy Mini Gnar"; row 3 prints Skill above whys[3] "Your Levels 4-5 ... lets you punch back".
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill, Zaahen, Gnar, Zaahen, Skill, Gnar, Gnar, and the mirror audit records that exact sequence being applied as one atomic group across both layers.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 3 set to Zaahen in both layers as matched pairs, ratings raised to 6/10. Rows 0, 2, 4, 5, 6 already match the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks "GNAR!'s cooldown" as the matchup-defining timer but never states it, and names none of Gnar's lane cooldowns.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30 — it drops to half a minute by rank 3, which is why the late game is his and why 'wait for his ult' stops being advice. Hop is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, the longest thing he holds in lane and his only escape. Boomerang Throw is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 but refunds cooldown if he catches it. Wallop and Hyper share a flat 7s.
audit.corrected: GNAR!'s 90s, Hop's 22s, Boomerang's 16s-with-catch-refund and Wallop's 7s written into the phases, spikes and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) Two fabricated Zaahen ability names: "Golden Onslaught" for the E (really Aureate Rush) in four fields, and "Final Retribution" for the R (really Grim Deliverance) in two. (b) whys[3] and spikes[1] call Grim Deliverance a "reset" — it is a rise-and-stab that heals him for part of the damage, no reset involved. (c) spikes[0] and mid slot Hyper as the E; Hyper is Mini Gnar's W, Hop is the E.
audit.why: Kit text: W "Gnar's attacks and spells hype him up" / Mega "Wallop"; E "Gnar leaps to a location and bounces off the head of any unit" / Mega "Crunch". A player told Hyper is the E will wait for the wrong cooldown before dashing in. Zaahen's R text is "rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt" — calling it a reset promises a mechanic that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Real names throughout, Hyper corrected to the W slot, Grim Deliverance described as the heal it is. Also stated: GNAR!'s wall-slam is what turns it from a slow into a stun, so the terrain you stand near decides the fight.

edits.before: Your core trade pattern comes online — test it on his cooldown. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: Mini Gnar is squishy and Aureate Rush walks him down before Boomerang's 16s comes back.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around GNAR!'s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 swing to you: Hop is 22s at rank 1, so the moment he spends it in Mini form, commit the full pattern and bank the lead.

edits.before: At Level 2 you out-stat squishy Mini Gnar and can walk him down with Golden Onslaught.
edits.after: At Level 2 you out-stat squishy Mini Gnar and can walk him down with Aureate Rush on 10s.

edits.before: Your Levels 4-5 Final Retribution reset lets you punch back through a Mini-form window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Grim Deliverance heals off its damage, punching back through a Mini-form window.

edits.before: Mini Gnar's Level 2-3 with Boomerang (Q) plus Hyper (E) into Hop lets him kite your Golden Onslaught (E) engages; play the E as a gap-closer only when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Mini Gnar kites with Boomerang Throw (Q), Hyper (W) and Hop (E) — Hyper is the W, not the E. Hold Aureate Rush until Boomerang is spent: 16s at rank 1, less if he catches it.

edits.before: Your Final Retribution (R) is a hard reset button on his fight; the danger is Mega Gnar's own R (GNAR!) knocking you into his tower or minions, so bait his transform bar down before you commit ult.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance (R) heals you for part of its own damage on 110s; the danger is GNAR! slamming you into a wall for the stun, and that is only 90s at rank 1, so bait his Rage bar down first.

edits.before: Once he hits Mega Gnar rhythm with a completed item, his Wallop stun plus GNAR! wall-slam out-trades your sustain window; respect the transform timer over the raw level.
edits.after: Once Mega Gnar has an item, Wallop on a flat 7s plus the GNAR! wall-slam out-trades your sustain window; respect the Rage bar over the raw level — the transform times his all-in.

edits.before: At Levels 1-2 it is a farm lane and a pure skill check, but once you hit 2 you can walk him down with Golden Onslaught (E) and stick Darkin Glaive (Q) marks while he is stuck in squishy Mini form.
edits.after: At Levels 1-2 it is a farm lane and a pure skill check, but once you hit 2 you walk him down with Aureate Rush (E) on 10s and heal off The Darkin Glaive (Q) while he is stuck in squishy Mini form.

edits.before: By Level 3 his Boomerang + Hyper + Hop kite pattern starts winning the extended dance and his Rage bar begins gating your all-ins; your Level 4-5 R power then swings a single spike back to you if you catch a Mini-form window.
edits.after: By Level 3 his Boomerang, Hyper and Hop kite pattern wins the extended dance and the Rage bar gates your all-ins; Hop is 22s at rank 1, so levels 4-5 swing back to you the moment he spends it in Mini form.

edits.before: Catch him in Mini form with Golden Onslaught while his Hop/E is down
edits.after: Catch him in Mini form with Aureate Rush while his Hop (E) is down

edits.before: Bleed him with Darkin Glaive (Q) poke so he can't freely last-hit
edits.after: Bleed him with The Darkin Glaive (Q) so he can't freely last-hit

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Dodge/avoid it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - GNAR! (R): 90s at rank 1 — the wall-slam stun is the whole all-in, so never fight with terrain behind you. - Hop (E): 22s, his only escape. - Grim Deliverance (R): 110s, heals off its damage.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Dodge/avoid it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His Mega all-in, 90s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent or baited.

edits.before: Your R is the kill window — build your teamfight around that. Gnar carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage on 110s — build the fight around it. Gnar threat 8/10: sidelane rather than group into his Mega-form AoE.

notes: Same two fabricated Zaahen names as the mirror found — 'Golden Onslaught' (Aureate Rush) and 'Final Retribution' (Grim Deliverance) — and 'Golden Onslaught' has now turned up in zaahen__gangplank and zaahen__garen too, so it is templated across the champion rather than a one-off; a repo-wide grep for both strings before release would be worth doing. New error not in the mirror: two fields slot Hyper as Gnar's E. Hyper is the Mini-form W, Hop is the E, and the difference matters because the page tells you to dash in when 'his E' is down.
